data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: Monday
sections.question: Monday
sections.summary: the first day of the working week, between Sunday and Tuesday

senses.definition: the first day of the working week, coming after Sunday and before Tuesday
examples: She goes back to school on Monday.
He starts his new job on Monday.

answers.answer: She goes back to school on Monday.
Monday is the last day of the working week.
Monday comes after Tuesday.
Monday is a weekend day.

sections.title: November
sections.question: November
sections.summary: the eleventh month of the year, between October and December

senses.definition: the eleventh month of the year, coming after October and before December
examples: It is cold and rainy in November.
He has a birthday in November.

answers.answer: It is cold and rainy in November.
November is the first month of the year.
November comes before October.
November is a summer month.

sections.title: October
sections.question: October
sections.summary: the tenth month of the year, between September and November

senses.definition: the tenth month of the year, coming after September and before November
examples: Halloween is on the thirty-first of October.
The leaves fall from the trees in October.

answers.answer: Halloween is on the thirty-first of October.
October is the first month of the year.
October comes after November.
October is a summer month.

sections.title: Saturday
sections.question: Saturday
sections.summary: the day after Friday and before Sunday; the first day of the weekend

senses.definition: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday; the first day of the weekend
examples: She goes shopping on Saturday morning.
He plays football on Saturday afternoon.

answers.answer: She goes shopping on Saturday morning.
Saturday is a school day for most children.
Saturday comes before Friday.
Saturday comes after Sunday.

sections.title: September
sections.question: September
sections.summary: the ninth month of the year, between August and October

senses.definition: the ninth month of the year, coming after August and before October
examples: School goes back in September.
Her birthday is in September.

answers.answer: School goes back in September.
September is the first month of the year.
September comes after October.
September is a winter month.

sections.title: Sunday
sections.question: Sunday
sections.summary: the last day of the week, after Saturday; the second day of the weekend

senses.definition: the last day of the week, coming after Saturday; the second day of the weekend
examples: He has a big family lunch on Sunday.
She goes for a walk on Sunday afternoon.

answers.answer: He has a big family lunch on Sunday.
Sunday is the first day of the working week.
Sunday comes before Saturday.
Sunday is between Monday and Tuesday.

sections.title: Thursday
sections.question: Thursday
sections.summary: the fourth day of the working week, between Wednesday and Friday

senses.definition: the day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday
examples: She has her English class on Thursday.
He plays tennis every Thursday evening.

answers.answer: She has her English class on Thursday.
Thursday is the last day of the working week.
Thursday comes after Friday.
Thursday is between Monday and Tuesday.

sections.title: Tuesday
sections.question: Tuesday
sections.summary: the second day of the working week, between Monday and Wednesday

senses.definition: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday
examples: She goes to the gym every Tuesday.
He has a meeting at work on Tuesday.

answers.answer: She goes to the gym every Tuesday.
Tuesday is the last day of the working week.
Tuesday comes after Wednesday.
Tuesday is between Thursday and Friday.

sections.title: Wednesday
sections.question: Wednesday
sections.summary: the third day of the working week, between Tuesday and Thursday

senses.definition: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday; the middle of the working week
examples: She has a dentist appointment on Wednesday.
He works from home every Wednesday.

answers.answer: She has a dentist appointment on Wednesday.
Wednesday is the last day of the working week.
Wednesday comes after Thursday.
Wednesday is between Monday and Tuesday.

sections.title: afternoon
sections.question: afternoon
sections.summary: the part of the day between 12 o'clock and the evening

senses.definition: the part of the day between 12 o'clock (midday) and the time when it starts to get dark
examples: She goes for a walk in the afternoon.
He finishes work at five in the afternoon.

answers.answer: She goes for a walk in the afternoon.
The afternoon is the part of the day before 12 o'clock.
Afternoon comes after evening.
The afternoon starts at midnight.
